DHAKA, Jan. 31 (Xinhua) -- In an apparent bid to ease the subsidy burden, the Bangladeshi government has again raised the prices of power at both the wholesale and retail levels.

The new rates will come into effect from Feb. 1, 2023, according to a notice from the ministry of power, energy and mineral resources.
